regime.label: Short-gamma below the 1110 flip, fresh far-OTM put insurance, 1080 call wall capping
evidence: 1110 is the cumulative-GEX zero crossing; spot 1077.3 sits 32.7 pts below it, and net GEX is negative at every strike from 930 to 1070 (-4,200 baht/pt cumulative through 1070) - dealers hedge downside moves with the move.

11,301 put OI at the 910 strike (15.5% below spot) grew +562 on 563 lots traded, 41% of the day's entire 1,361-lot put volume - live crash insurance, not stale OI (Vol2Vol: volume + OI build confirmed, but price is far away, so 910 is insurance, not support).

2,296 call OI at 1080 with 82 lots traded is the largest single node in the chain and sits 2.7 pts above spot; it carries +2,000 baht/pt of positive GEX, so rallies into 1080-1100 are dampened while breaks below 1070 are amplified.
13.02% ATM IV is the 8-session low (14.10% on 2026-08-01) while 25d skew widened to +1.80 from -0.02 on 2026-08-07 - vol is cheap in level but the protection bid is paying up in the tails.

S50U26.today_summary: 1077.3 closed +0.8 and 7.3 pts (0.83 sigma) above the 1070 max pain, inside a structure that has not moved for eight sessions: 1080 call wall, 1050 near put wall, 1110 gamma flip all unchanged. 30,455 put OI vs 17,173 call OI (P/C 1.77) is the burden map - the weight is parked in puts, and today's flow doubled the put lean with a 2.03 volume ratio vs 1.14 prior. 563 of those put lots hit the 910 strike, lifting it to 11,301 OI - that is portfolio insurance being bought 15.5% out of the money, not a directional bet on 910. Dealers are short gamma across the whole 930-1070 band and long gamma at 1080-1150, an asymmetry that dampens rallies into the walls and accelerates breaks below 1070.
what_changed: Put/call volume ratio 2.03, up from 1.14 - the heaviest put-side flow day in the visible history and the first reading above 2.0.
910-strike put OI 11,301, +562 in one session on 563 lots - the single largest strike-level build in the chain.
25d IV skew +1.80 vs -0.02 on 2026-08-07 - a 1.82-pt swing from balanced to firmly put-rich in five sessions.
ATM IV 13.02% vs 13.50% on 2026-08-07 and 14.10% on 2026-08-01 - 1.08 pts of compression, cutting the 1-sigma day from 9.18 to 8.83 pts.
S50U26.five_day_thesis: The option structure has been frozen for five sessions - 1080 call wall, 1050 near put wall, 1110 gamma flip and 1070 max pain are all unchanged since 2026-08-05 - while spot has done nothing (1079.5 on 08-07 to 1077.3, -2.2 pts) and ATM IV bled 0.48 pts to 13.02%. What moved instead is the tails: put OI +1,067 to 30,455 against call OI +447 to 17,173, and 25d skew from -0.02 to +1.80, so the market is paying up for downside convexity while refusing to bid the ATM. That combination - flat spot, compressing ATM vol, widening skew, OI still building 47 days out - is the Protection signature, not a pin: at 47 DTE there is no expiry magnet, and the 1070 max pain is an anchor with no gravity yet. The risk in a frozen structure is that the 1080 call wall keeps capping (2,296 OI, positive GEX overhead) until something forces spot through 1070, at which point the negative GEX from 1060 down to 930 means dealer hedging sells into the decline rather than cushioning it. Watch whether the 910 put build continues: a second 500-lot day there would confirm real hedging demand rather than a single roll.

strategies.name: Put debit spread 1050 / 1010
strategies.rationale: 13.02% ATM IV is the 8-session low, so downside convexity is cheap in level terms, and the 1050 near put wall (1,299 OI) is the trigger strike - a break there drops spot into the negative-GEX band where dealer hedging amplifies rather than fades the move.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = net debit 7.1 pts (10.6 - 3.5), 1,420 baht at 200 baht/pt. Max value 40 - 7.1 = 32.9 pts below 1010.
strategies.invalidation: A close back above the 1080 call wall - positive GEX overhead reasserts and the short-gamma downside path is off the table.

strategies.name: Bear call spread 1100 / 1120
strategies.rationale: 1,965 call OI at 1100 with 151 lots traded today is the live upside node above the 1080 wall, and positive dealer gamma at 1080-1110 means hedging sells rallies into it; 1110 is also the 25d call band, the statistical edge of the normal range.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = 20 - 5.5 net credit = 14.5 pts, 2,900 baht at 200 baht/pt.
strategies.invalidation: A close above 1100 on expanding call volume - that is the gamma flip at 1110 coming into play and the cap failing.

strategies.name: Iron condor 1020 / 1040 put x 1110 / 1130 call
strategies.rationale: The short strikes sit exactly on the 25d delta bands (1040 put, 1110 call) that mark the normal-range edges, and the eight-session freeze in walls, flip and max pain is the structural case for range - but 13.02% IV is the cycle low, so this is the poorly-paid side of the two-axis matrix and belongs in small size.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = 20 wing - 7.55 total credit = 12.45 pts per side, 2,490 baht at 200 baht/pt. Short-vol payoff is negative-skew: frequent small gains, rare full-width losses.
strategies.invalidation: A close outside 1040 or 1110 - below 1040 the negative-GEX band takes over, above 1110 the gamma flip inverts the hedging response.

S50U26.prediction: 1050-1090 is the base case for the next five sessions: 8.83 pts of 1-sigma daily move implies a 19.7-pt 5-day sigma, and the 1080 call wall plus positive overhead GEX argue the upper half is capped near 1090-1100. The bias tilts mildly lower on the +1.80 skew and 2.03 put volume ratio, but flat spot and a frozen structure mean this is a grind, not a trend. A daily close below 1070 (max pain, and the top of the negative-GEX band) invalidates the range read and opens 1050 then 1040; a close above 1100 invalidates the bearish tilt entirely.
S50U26.risk_note: Educational analysis only - not trade advice, and no position is being recommended. SET50 options are European and cash-settled on the SET50 index, so there is no physical delivery pressure and any pull toward 1070 max pain is a tendency, not a mechanism - pinning is structurally weaker here than for share-settled single stocks, and at 47 DTE it is weaker still. Defined-risk does not mean low-risk: the stated max losses (7.1 / 14.5 / 12.45 pts) are real and can be lost in full. Data caveat: the 2026-08-12 snapshot is byte-identical to 2026-08-11, so 1-day deltas are measured against 2026-08-11 and 5-day deltas against the 2026-08-07 session; the 2026-08-14 scrape had not landed when this was generated.
